facts.anchor: Until Elise gets curtains she will wake with the sun.
facts.fact: Elise 在巴黎的住处还没装上窗帘，天亮就醒；出门前她在洗手池边给自己擦洗身体。

facts.anchor: Everyone must wear black to make their bodies into a backdrop
facts.fact: 学校规定所有人必须穿黑，让身体成为背景、抹掉个性与性别的表达。

facts.anchor: Then Elisabeth told her what was in the envelope. Paris. Clowns.
facts.fact: Catherine 洗碗时，女儿 Elisabeth 告诉她信封里写的是去巴黎、当小丑。

facts.anchor: Her daughter’s first word was dada. Came long before mama.
facts.fact: Catherine 说女儿 Elisabeth 的第一个词是 dada，比 mama 早得多，即女儿最亲爸爸。

facts.anchor: It’s been five weeks since she has seen her daughter
facts.fact: Catherine 已经五周没见到女儿。

facts.anchor: I’m thinking of coming to Paris for a little visit! Just a week or so.
facts.fact: Catherine 在瀑布边打电话告诉 Elisabeth，她想下周去巴黎看她，待一周左右。

facts.anchor: Class will be ten hours a day, five days a week.
facts.fact: Tomas 宣布课程每天十小时、每周五天。

facts.anchor: What made her think that she was the kind of girl who could do this?
facts.fact: 结尾 Elise 被 Tomas 判为做得相反、仍在哭的情况下离开光圈，末句自问她凭什么以为自己能做这件事。
